content.text: Nothing checked for Saturday, Aug 8 yet. The one web result was a toddler class, so it's no good for Milo and Ada. The standing option is High Park in the west end, at Bloor St W and Parkside Dr. It has the Jamie Bell Adventure Playground, a free animal display with bison, llamas and peacocks, a wading pool and splash pads, and trails. The park is open daily, and the water play is seasonal. Saturday looks hot and dry, with a high of 29 and no rain in the forecast, so the splash pads should work well.
